empty: No scheduled probe yet. Use the + button to add one.

form.modelEmpty: This channel has no model yet. Add one on the channel page first.
form.intervalHint: One target is probed per round, rotating in creation order; the actual interval carries a ±30s jitter so upstreams are not hit at the same instant.
form.windowHint: No weekday selected means always on; otherwise probing happens only inside the chosen weekdays and hours, and is skipped outside them.
form.windowSameDay: The end hour is exclusive; equal hours mean the whole day.
form.windowCrossMidnight: A start later than the end means the window crosses midnight, for example 22:00 to 05:00 next day.

toast.createFailed: Failed to create the scheduled probe
